create_config_jais2: create a Jais2Config instance with default model configuration for the Jais-2-8B-Chat model
build_config_from_dict: build a Jais2Config from a dictionary of model parameters including hidden_size, num_hidden_layers, and vocab_size
validate_jais2_architecture: validate the Jais2Config architecture to ensure hidden_size is a multiple of num_attention_heads
initialize_jais2_model: initialize a Jais2Model with a Jais2Config for the jais2-7b style configuration
access_model_config: access the model configuration from an instantiated Jais2Model via model.config
